message: さっちんのラブラブ大作戦１

name: Sacchin
message: 「Did you make any progress today?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I didn't have time for that. A strong Demon showed up--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「None of that matters! Nana-chan, Synn-kun is number one, peace is number two, and three o'clock snacks are from Sans Souci!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You're right」

name: Sacchin
message: 「First of all, you can't be saying things like 'I didn't have time for that'」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Now repeat after me! Synn-kun is number one, peace is number two, and three o'clock snacks are from Sans Souci!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn is number one, peace is number two, and three o'clock snacks are from Sans Souci!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So, how did it go?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Blah, blah, blah」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're hopeless, Nana-chan. Even though you're childhood friends! You don't have any epoch-making memories at all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No! I'll remember one eventually, probably. We've known each other for so many years, after all... there's gotta be at least one, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Why are you asking me? 'Eventually' will be too late. Besides, shouldn't you at least have made a promise to get married? Normally, if you're childhood friends」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Ugh... A promise to get married, something that embarrassing... there's no way I'd ever do that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Still, without enough distance on your hit, you won't be able to make a comeback」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But I haven't fallen behind enough to need a comeback yet...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Listen here, Nana-chan. You think you're in the lead, but you're actually a whole lap behind. This isn't even soccer, yet your finishing power is way too weak」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... It's shocking that I'm only realizing that now too...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Look, I don't think Synn-kun dislikes you or anything, Nana-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Right?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No matter how lacking in the chest you are, or how making soba is your only skill, you two have kept hanging out regardless of all that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pick whether you're encouraging me or insulting me!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's a calm assessment of the situation. Tough love, you know」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Anyway, at this point, I think a direct approach is your only option」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-A direct approach? I-I get it, an exchange diary!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「How are you taking such a huge detour that you're getting lost? You're not a kid in mind or body anymore, you know--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Right. An adult, an adult relationship in both mind and body----」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, what are you making me say!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You pervert, Nana-chan. Don't self-destruct when nobody even said anything--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's not what I mean. You make up an excuse to meet up alone, or end up alone together--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Something right out of a manga or drama like that! There's no way I can do that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Jeez, that's no good, Nana-chan. A woman needs guts--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A woman needs... guts...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Exactly! Got it now--?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Understood, Master!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ahem. Leave it to me--」
